name: google-workspace
description: Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, Tasks, Chat) via the workspace-mcp server. Requires `uv`/`uvx` on the host and a Google Cloud OAuth client; add your OAuth client ID + secret to enable. First use opens a browser for the OAuth consent flow.

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.title: Google OAuth client ID
GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth 2.0 client ID from Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services → Credentials). Ends in .apps.googleusercontent.com. A Desktop app client is recommended (PKCE, no redirect URI to register).

GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.title: Google OAuth client secret
GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret paired with the OAuth client ID. Required for Desktop/Web clients. Stored in your system keychain, never written to the repo.

USER_GOOGLE_EMAIL.title: Default Google account email (optional)
USER_GOOGLE_EMAIL.description: Your Workspace email. Sets a default account so you aren't asked to pick one on every auth. Leave blank to choose interactively.
